title: Order
description: A request to generate one image.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

key.description: Order key; slash-separated safe segments, no leading slash and no .. segments.

profile.description: Name of the project profile to use.

references.description: Reference image paths, relative to the project root.

initImage.description: Initial image for img2img, relative to the project root.

strength.description: How far img2img departs from initImage (0 to 1); needs initImage.

params.description: Per-order overrides of the profile sampling settings.

draft.description: Generate drafts (D32): the profile draft settings, or half size and 8 steps.

profileName.description: Profile name: lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, no hyphens (the profile is what follows the last hyphen in delivered file names).

relativePath.description: Relative path that cannot be absolute, start with ~, contain .. segments, backslashes or control characters.
